chunks: Another text: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Bareqi, on the authority of Soleiman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, who said:

I went to see Abul Hassan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them). I wanted to ask him about the Divine Leader (Imam) after him. When he looked at me, he initiated the conversation and said, 'O Soleiman! Ali is my son, my Testamentary Trustee and the Divine Leader (Imam) of the people after me. He is my noblest child. If you live after me, then witness on his behalf to my followers and my friends who want to know about my successor after me.'

key_terms.الْحُجَّةَ: The Divine Proof/Imam, the authoritative proof upon people

ai.seo_question: Who did Imam Musa al-Kazim appoint as his successor and proof upon people?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the explicit designation (naṣṣ) of Imam Musa al-Kazim (a.s.), confirming Ali al-Rida (a.s.) as the testamentary trustee (waṣī) and the definitive proof (ḥujjah) upon humanity. The instruction for Soleiman ibn Hafs to bear witness among the 'inquirers' underscores the Shia emphasis on continuous, verified lineage of authority, linking the Imams' succession directly to the Prophet’s legacy. This event is pivotal in establishing the legitimacy of the eighth Imam within the broader context of the Twelve Imams.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-11 In another tradition it is narrated that Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja’far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Bareqi, on the authority of Soleiman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi, “I went to see Abul Hassan Musa ibn Ja’far (s). I wanted to ask about the Divine Leader (Imam) after him. He (s) looked at me. Before I asked any question he (s) said, ‘O Soleiman! Ali (Al-Ridha (s)) is my son, my Testamentary Trustee and the DivineLeader (Imam) of the people after me. He is my noblest child. Then witness on his behalf to my followers and my friends who want to know about my successor if you live after me.’”
